Method of Attack: Remote access trojan using Telegram API for C2 communication, including commands and file exfiltration (NineRAT)
Trojan and downloader executing hard-coded commands to collect system info and download/upload files (DLRAT)
Malware downloader fetching and executing payloads via PowerShell, establishing persistence, and exfiltrating files (BottomLoader)
Impacted Systems: Publicly facing VMWare Horizon servers using vulnerable Log4j versions
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) vulnerability in Log4j on VMWare Horizon servers
